_comment: Change 'handle' to post from a different account. The script checks it is logged in as this exact handle before it posts anything, so a wrong handle stops the run instead of posting to the wrong account.
_formats: Which outputs a message's tone chip produces. fury earns the beating reel, soft stays a quiet story card; everything gets the feed post.
caption: say the thing you'd never say. anonymous, free, at beatass.com
_outreach: A DM from an account you do not follow lands in Instagram's 'Message requests' folder, which most people never open. These three things point people at that folder: we follow them (so they get a notification and read our bio), our bio tells them a message is waiting, and we leave one comment on their latest post. Set follow or comment to false to switch either off without touching code. The per-day numbers are deliberately below what Instagram tolerates - follows and comments to strangers are what gets an account limited, and a limited account cannot DM anybody.

outreach._comments: One is picked per handle, so the same person always sees the same line and fifty different people do not all get an identical comment. Every line must say where the message actually is: the requests folder.
comments: someone left you an anonymous message on beatass.com. instagram filed it under your DM requests
we passed you an anonymous message and instagram hid it in your DM requests. worth a look
check your DM requests. somebody sent you an anonymous message through beatass.com

you have an anonymous message from beatass.com sitting in your DM requests folder
outreach._bio: Our own profile bio, 150 characters max. Someone we just followed clicks the notification, lands here, and this is the only thing that tells them why. Set it with: node tools/instagram/outreach.mjs --bio --apply
outreach.bio:
say the thing you'd never say.
we followed you? someone sent you a message - check your DM requests.
anonymous. free. no login.

_headless: false lets you watch it work, which is what you want the first few times. true runs it invisibly.
